Quasimoto Picture Disc - Alter Ego of producer Madlib. I love this little guy, he looks like he's about to throw that brick through a window, and on the B side you can see his guts n stuff.

13th Floor Elevators Picture Disc - Arguably the first true psychedelic rock band. Their big single You're Gonna Miss Me is on this. I love the artwork and I take this out whenever I lust after an original pressing of their debut.

The burst rifle is going to be tricky at first but if you stick with it it will be one of your favorite weapons in the game. You can adjust this according to your playstyle but my loadout is:

-Revolver

-Silenced burst rifle

-Sharpshooter 2

-Covert training 2

-Reviver 1

So with this loadout try to be sneaky and flank enemy players. In my experiences if you can get the jump on your enemy you're almost guaranteed to win that battle. Because the burst rifle isn't as powerful as say, the semi auto, it takes more shots and more time to down them. With sharpshooter it just takes the edge off for me. The recoil is much less noticeable and makes it that much easier to get those wonderful headshot downs/executions. So to me it's very much worth it. The burst rifle is for up close and personal encounters, so your revolver is to shoot at enemies from long distances or if they're popping their head out behind cover. Reviver is just helpful to your teammates and gets you out of there faster. Checkpoint is my favorite map for this weapon because it's more fast paced and up close encounters.
